title: 数据洪流
source: 《伏羲纪元》第一集，严格遵循原剧本

scenes.name: 灵子文明首都·数据中枢

shots.action: 极致璀璨的未来都市。建筑由光构成，数据河流在空中流淌。突然，所有光芒开始抽搐，城市响起刺耳警报。
shots.prompt_visual: breathtaking futuristic city built entirely of light, luminous architecture, rivers of data flowing through the sky between buildings, suddenly all light begins glitching and stuttering, piercing alarm, city-scale emergency, vertical 9:16 framing
shots.prompt_motion: smooth crane down revealing city, then sudden glitch — all lights stutter and flicker, data streams fragment
shots.sfx_bgm: ethereal ambient → sudden alarm klaxon, electronic distortion
shots.notes: 强钩子开场：未来都市的壮美与毁灭形成强烈反差

shots.action: 羲和（30岁，身着流光长袍，左眼有金色纹路）站在中枢塔顶，手指在空中快速滑动，金色数据流随指尖飞舞。
shots.prompt_visual: East Asian man age 30, serene celestial sage bearing, standing atop central tower in flowing luminous robes with I-Ching inspired pattern details, golden spiral markings on left eye (太阳女神 Sun Goddess aspect), fingers rapidly swiping through holographic data with graceful precision, golden data streams responding to gestures like silk ribbons, city glitching in background, ethereal dramatic lighting illuminating delicate East Asian facial features
shots.prompt_motion: fingers dancing through holographic data, golden streams responding to gestures, background city flickering
shots.sfx_bgm: 观测者AI（温柔女声）：格式化程序已锁定本星球。剩余时间：17分42秒。
shots.notes: 建立羲和形象 + AI声音。观测者AI台词作为画外音

shots.action: 羲和微笑，从容决断。
shots.dialogue: 那就赌一把。以我灵子文明最后代码者之名——授权执行！
shots.prompt_visual: close-up of East Asian celestial sage age 30 with chiseled noble features, left eye glowing with golden spiral patterns (ancient I-Ching wisdom mark), wearing luminous flowing robes in white and gold with subtle Daoist geometry, serene yet resolute expression, calm determined smile conveying profound acceptance of sacrifice, golden data light reflections dancing across face, city alarm lights casting dramatic shadows in background
shots.prompt_motion: steady shot, subtle smile forming, eyes filled with resolve, slight head nod at 'authorize'
shots.sfx_bgm: music swells — heroic electronic theme
shots.notes: 核心台词：建立牺牲精神。需要演员级面部表演

shots.action: 羲和将双手按在控制台，全身数据被抽取。城市中心升起一道通天光柱，分裂为亿万光点洒向宇宙。最后一刻，一个光点中隐约可见八卦图案。
shots.prompt_visual: celestial East Asian sage pressing both hands on holographic console, luminous data being extracted from entire body in flowing light trails forming eight directions (八 I-Ching pattern), massive white and gold light pillar erupting from city center reaching into infinite sky, pillar fragmenting into billions of luminous points scattering into cosmos like dandelion seeds, one prominent light point contains glowing rotating bagua symbol (太极八卦), cosmic scale sacrifice
shots.prompt_motion: hands press down, data rips from body upward, light pillar erupts, camera pulls back to reveal cosmic scale, light points scatter like dandelion seeds
shots.sfx_bgm: epic crescendo, energy surge, cosmic expansion sound
shots.notes: 视觉高潮：牺牲→光柱→亿万光点。八卦光点为伏线

shots.action: 羲和身体逐渐透明，面带微笑说出最后的话。彻底消散。
shots.dialogue: 告诉下一个文明……要活得……有趣一点……
shots.prompt_visual: close-up of East Asian sage's face becoming transparent and dissolving into luminous particles, gentle knowing smile conveying 'live interesting' wisdom, golden spiral eye patterns fading into white light, delicate featured face gradually losing substance, body dissolving into flowing luminous data fragments drifting upward toward cosmos, wisps of white and gold light energy, bittersweet transcendent farewell moment
shots.prompt_motion: body slowly becoming transparent from edges inward, gentle smile held, dissolving into floating light particles, fade to white
shots.sfx_bgm: music drops to gentle piano/string, emotional
shots.notes: 全剧最动人时刻。台词必须清晰、节奏缓慢。闪白转场到下一场

shots.action: 硬切到原始世界。暴雨夜，沼泽地带。伏羲（16岁）与猎人正在追踪雷兽足迹。猎人甲抬头惊呼。
shots.prompt_visual: primitive swamp at stormy night, torrential rain, young East Asian boy 16 years old with noble bearing despite animal hide clothing, deep-set eyes suggesting hidden wisdom (伏羲 primordial sage aspect), and two adult East Asian hunters with strong tribal features carrying carved bone spears with ancestral markings, tracking beast footprints in mud with primal skill, one hunter pointing up at sky in sudden alarm, raw ancient landscape, East Asian tribal aesthetic
shots.prompt_motion: characters moving through rain, sudden stop, hunter pointing upward, all look up
shots.sfx_bgm: hard cut — thunder, rain, primal drums
shots.notes: 时空硬切：从极致未来到原始蛮荒。对比冲击最大化

shots.camera: wide_to_close, tilt up then rack focus
shots.action: 天空撕裂，不是闪电，而是银蓝色、有几何形状的光流——火种残迹。光流坠入沼泽中央。伏羲左眼突然刺痛。
shots.prompt_visual: sky tearing open with silver-blue geometric light streams (celestial fire seed 火种) falling — not lightning but sacred structured energy, crashing into swamp center creating glowing vortex of ancient power, young East Asian boy 16 with noble features clutching left eye in sudden searing pain, spiritual awakening beginning, rain illuminated by otherworldly silver-blue light, mystical moment
shots.prompt_motion: camera tilts up to sky, geometric light descends, crashes into swamp with splash, rack focus to boy gripping eye
shots.sfx_bgm: cosmic descent sound, impact, mysterious resonance
shots.notes: 火种降临：连接前世与今生。伏羲左眼共鸣是关键细节

shots.camera: medium_shot, eye level, slight push in
shots.action: 光流坠入沼泽中央，溶解成发光漩涡。漩涡中心浮着一块半透明晶体。伏羲独自走近。
shots.prompt_visual: glowing silver-blue vortex in swamp water, translucent geometric crystal floating at hypnotic center (原始密码晶体 primordial code crystal), young East Asian boy 16 in animal hide approaching cautiously with determination, noble bearing despite poverty of clothing, silver-blue mystical light reflecting on water and his East Asian features, eyes filled with recognition and calling, other hunters wisely staying back in fear
shots.prompt_motion: slow push in following boy toward vortex, light pulsing rhythmically
shots.sfx_bgm: low harmonic hum, magnetic pull sound
shots.notes: 过渡镜头：伏羲被漩涡吸引，独自走近

shots.action: 伏羲伸手触碰晶体。金色数据流顺手臂涌入！伏羲痛苦跪地，左眼爆发出强光。
shots.prompt_visual: extreme close-up of young East Asian hand touching translucent crystal, golden data streams erupting from crystal flowing up arm like luminous veins of ancestral code, cut to boy's noble face contorted in transformation pain kneeling in water, left eye erupting with intense golden light and spiral I-Ching patterns, ancient wisdom flooding consciousness, rain streaming down face in agony and ecstasy
shots.prompt_motion: finger touches crystal → instant golden energy eruption up arm → cut to face, dropping to knees, left eye flashing gold
shots.sfx_bgm: energy surge, electrical overload, pain cry
shots.notes: 觉醒核心时刻。手→臂→眼的能量传导路径必须清晰

shots.action: 左瞳孔变成暗金色，深处有微小八卦图案旋转。代码视觉首次展现：看树木=绿色生长代码串，看水面=分子结构网格，看自己手=皮肤下生物电流蓝线。
shots.prompt_visual: extreme close-up of left eye, pupil transformed to dark gold with tiny rotating bagua pattern (太极八卦 yin-yang Eight Trigrams) swirling with ancestral memory; transitions to first-person POV showing trees as emerald green flowing code strings of organic life, water surface as molecular crystalline grid structure of elemental essence, own East Asian hand showing blue bioelectric lines like acupuncture meridians under skin, sacred geometry awakening
shots.prompt_motion: eye close-up 1s, then POV shift — environment overlaid with data visualizations, camera panning across trees/water/hand
shots.sfx_bgm: digital awakening chime, data stream ambient
shots.notes: 三重代码视觉必须清晰呈现：绿色树木代码+分子水面+蓝色手部电流

shots.action: 伏羲震惊地看着自己的双手和周围的世界。
shots.dialogue: 世界……是由字和画组成的？
shots.prompt_visual: medium close-up of 16-year-old East Asian boy in animal hide, kneeling in shallow swamp water, looking at own hands in profound disbelief and wonder, faint golden spiral glow in left eye revealing I-Ching truth, rain falling on noble young face, expression of existential awakening — seeing the world's fundamental code/text nature for first time, shock mixed with dawning understanding
shots.prompt_motion: boy looking at hands, then slowly looking around at world, mouth slightly open
shots.sfx_bgm: moment of silence, then low tension build
shots.notes: 原剧本台词，必须一字不改。与前版'世界是代码'不同

shots.action: 天空骤然暗下。
shots.prompt_visual: wide high-angle shot of dark swamp, sky rapidly darkening beyond normal storm, unnatural shadow spreading, boy tiny in frame looking up, ominous atmospheric shift
shots.prompt_motion: sky darkening rapidly, light draining from scene, wind picking up
shots.sfx_bgm: deep bass drop, ominous sub-bass drone
shots.notes: 氛围急转：从觉醒惊奇到危险降临。情绪断裂点

shots.action: 三个苍白几何体（正八面体）无声降下。
shots.dialogue: 检测到异常代码残留。执行提取分析。
shots.prompt_visual: three pale white octahedron geometric entities descending silently from darkened sky, glowing red cracks on surfaces, floating motionless above swamp, cold alien presence, dwarfing the humans below
shots.prompt_motion: three shapes descending in formation, slow and silent, stopping to hover, red cracks pulsing
shots.sfx_bgm: mechanical voice delivering dialogue, low menacing drone
shots.notes: 熵单位首次登场。'无声降下'的静默感与机械音台词形成对比

shots.action: 黑色数据流卷向猎人乙，猎人身体开始像素化分解。
shots.prompt_visual: black corrupting data tendrils shooting from octahedron with terrible speed, wrapping around adult East Asian tribal hunter with strong features, his primal body beginning to pixelate and dissolve from feet upward into cubic digital fragments, expression of agony and incomprehension, other East Asian hunters watching in tribal horror and helplessness, moment of ancient world colliding with digital extinction
shots.prompt_motion: tendrils lashing out fast, coiling around victim, pixelation rising from feet to torso, struggling but dissolving
shots.sfx_bgm: digital distortion noise, hunter's scream
shots.notes: 像素化分解：展示熵单位的致命威胁。必须触目惊心

shots.action: 伏羲怒吼伸手。代码视觉中看到黑色数据流的锯齿结构，本能'抓住'并扯断！
shots.prompt_visual: close-up of East Asian boy's face screaming in rage and primal power, left eye blazing with intense golden light and I-Ching patterns, ancestral fury awakened; cut to code-vision POV showing black tendril's jagged corrupted data structure highlighted in red; young hand reaching out with instinctive authority and grabbing tendril, golden sacred energy flowing from hand causing black corruption to shatter into digital fragments, code-level manipulation manifesting
shots.prompt_motion: face snap with rage, POV shift to code vision, hand grabs tendril, golden energy pulse, tendril shatters
shots.sfx_bgm: rage cry, data fracture sound, shattering glass
shots.notes: 首次代码操控：本能反应而非主动使用。强调'无意识伸手'

shots.action: 熵单位判断威胁提升。更多数据触手伸出。伏羲尝试操控地面代码，让泥土变流沙，困住单位片刻。
shots.subtitle: 异常：原生代码操控能力。威胁等级提升。
shots.prompt_visual: full shot of 16-year-old East Asian boy facing three floating octahedra, more black corrupting tendrils extending, boy slams hands on muddy ground with desperate instinctive power, golden sacred energy ripples outward turning solid soil into flowing quicksand beneath the geometric entities, entities sinking and wobbling in surprise, struggling against transformed earth code
shots.prompt_motion: tendrils reaching, boy drops to ground, golden pulse from hands, mud liquefying, entities wobbling as ground shifts
shots.sfx_bgm: 熵单位机械音台词 + ground rumbling
shots.notes: 伏羲首次主动操控：泥土→流沙。但只是'困住片刻'，非击败

shots.action: 远处山崖，一支缠绕绿光的骨箭射来！女娲（17岁）现身高喊。伏羲踉跄逃离。
shots.prompt_visual: wide shot: glowing green bone arrow streaking through rain from distant cliff with ethereal green sacred light; on cliff stands young East Asian girl 17 with fierce intelligent beauty, wearing green leaf-woven armor woven with natural plant spirits (女娲 Goddess of Creation aspect), wielding white ancestral bone bow with masterful grace, shouting command to escape, surrounded by swamp mist and rain; below in swamp the boy stumbles and runs from entities, geometric threats momentarily distracted by arrow impact, two destinies converging
shots.prompt_motion: arrow flies across frame trailing green light, impacts near entities, cut to girl on cliff shouting, cut to boy stumbling away through swamp water
shots.sfx_bgm: arrow whistle, impact, urgent drum beat
shots.notes: 女娲首次登场：远景+绿光骨箭+高喊。必须鲜明但不过度展开

shots.action: 几何体汇合。熵单位发出最终报告。
shots.prompt_visual: three octahedron entities regrouping in formation, red cracks pulsing in synchronized pattern, scanning the swamp where targets fled, cold mechanical precision, rain passing through their geometric forms
shots.prompt_motion: entities floating together, red cracks synchronizing pulse, slow rotation
shots.sfx_bgm: 熵单位机械音：目标丢失。标记该星球存在原生代码操控者。向中央仲裁者发送报告……
shots.notes: '中央仲裁者'是全剧Boss伏线。机械音台词必须冰冷

shots.action: 伏羲在雨中回头望，左眼在黑暗中发出微弱金光。惊恐、困惑、但活着。
shots.emotion: shaken survival, lingering fear, questions unanswered
shots.prompt_visual: medium close-up of 16-year-old East Asian boy pausing in rain, looking back over shoulder with haunted expression, breathing hard and trembling, left eye emitting faint but persistent golden glow and spiral patterns in darkness, expression of profound shock and confusion mixed with awe of survival, rain streaking down noble young face, ancient primordial swamp looming behind, threshold moment between two worlds
shots.prompt_motion: boy stops running, turns to look back, heavy breathing, left eye glows faintly, holds gaze then turns away
shots.sfx_bgm: rain ambient, heartbeat fading, low suspense tone
shots.notes: 伏羲结尾镜头：不是胜利而是逃离后的震惊。与前版'霸气金句'完全不同

shots.action: 黑屏 + 本集终字样
shots.subtitle: 本集终
shots.prompt_visual: pure black screen with white text fading in
shots.prompt_motion: text fade in 1s, hold 1s
shots.sfx_bgm: suspense tail-out, silence
shots.notes: 简洁收尾
